definitions.explanation: In soccer, a midfielder who plays just in front of the defense, breaking up opposing attacks and distributing the ball. From Portuguese 'volante'.

examples.japanese: ボランチ⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{出場|しゅつじょう}する→出場する：20348_shutsujousuru⟧。
ボランチ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{守備|しゅび}→守備：15509_shubi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つなぐ。
examples.english: The defensive midfielder links defense and attack.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧ボランチ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: An excellent defensive midfielder has a strong ability to read the flow of the whole game.

notes:
From Portuguese 'volante' (steering wheel), reflecting the role of controlling the team's play from in front of the defense. A defensive or holding midfielder.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ボランチ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to play defensive midfield
- ⟦{守備的|しゅびてき}→守備的：29431_shubiteki⟧ボランチ: a holding (defensive) midfielder

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦サイドハーフ→サイドハーフ：30061_saidohaafu⟧: side midfielder — plays wide rather than centrally
- ⟦センターバック→センターバック：30058_sentaabakku⟧: center back — plays behind the ボランチ, in defense
